expectations.buyer: Software supply-chain, legal, security, open-source programme, platform engineering, and product release teams
expectations.pain: An upstream package or dependency tree changes license or attribution obligations and the affected shipped products or import paths are not identified before release
expectations.strongestIncumbent: GitHub dependency review, Dependabot, SCA vendors, SBOM tools, package metadata, SPDX, legal review, and repository policy gates
expectations.biggestRisk: Mature SCA products already flag licenses, package metadata can be wrong, legal effect is context-specific, and import-path reachability is not distribution or derivative-work analysis
